sloka: अथवा ऽहं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भिन्नगात्रं महारणे।भवद्भिः श्वो निहन्तास्मि रामं लोकस्य पश्यतः ।। ६.९४.५ ।।
transliteration: athavā 'haṁ śaraistīkṣṇairbhinnagātraṁ mahāraṇe।bhavadbhiḥ śvo nihantāsmi rāmaṁ lokasya paśyataḥ ।। 6.94.5 ।।

translations.english: "I shall kill him with huge sharp arrows as the world looks at Rama, once his limbs are struck by you."
